texts.value: Involved in repair of UV radiation-induced DNA damage. Catalyzes the light-dependent monomerization (300-600 nm) of cyclobutyl pyrimidine dimers (in cis-syn configuration), which are formed between adjacent bases on the same DNA strand upon exposure to ultraviolet radiation
There are only 10-20 molecules of photolyase per E.coli cell
Upon absorption of visible light electrons are transferred from Trp-307 through Trp-360 to Trp 383, and from there to FADH, giving rise to the fully reduced catalytic FADH(-)
Belongs to the DNA photolyase class-1 family
